title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 43
description: Ten questions on Genesis 43: the brothers return to Egypt with Benjamin and dine at Joseph's house.

questions.text: Which brother reminded Israel that the man said, "You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you"?
questions.explanation: Judah told his father that the man had solemnly warned them they would not see his face unless their brother was with them.

questions.text: What did Judah offer to be for Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Judah said, "I'll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him," and he would bear the blame forever if he failed.

questions.text: Which of these did Israel tell his sons to carry down as a present for the man?
questions.explanation: Israel told them to carry a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts and almonds.

questions.text: How much money did Israel tell his sons to take with them?
questions.explanation: Israel said, "Take double money in your hand," and also to take back the money that was returned in their sacks.

answers.text: Exactly the same amount as before

questions.text: At what time did Joseph say the men would dine with him?
questions.explanation: Joseph told the steward of his house to prepare, "for the men will dine with me at noon."

questions.text: Why were the brothers afraid when they were brought to Joseph's house?
questions.explanation: They feared it was because of the money returned in their sacks the first time, and that they would be seized as slaves.

answers.text: Because of the money returned in their sacks
Because they had lied about their father
Because they had come without a present

questions.text: Whom did the steward bring out to the brothers?
questions.explanation: After telling them not to be afraid, the steward brought Simeon out to them.

questions.text: What did Joseph do when his heart yearned over his brother Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Joseph hurried and sought a place to weep; he entered into his room and wept there.

answers.text: He told them who he was
He gave Benjamin a silver cup
He went into his room and wept
He left the house for the night

questions.text: Why did the Egyptians eat separately from the Hebrews?
questions.explanation: The Egyptians don't eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

answers.text: It was an abomination to the Egyptians
The Hebrews preferred to eat alone

questions.text: How much larger was Benjamin's portion than any of his brothers'?
questions.explanation: Joseph sent portions to them, but Benjamin's portion was five times as much as any of theirs.
